replication.target_description: Published article, p. 120, Meta-analysis: random-effects meta-analysis of Experiments 1 and 2 only, comparing process versus outcome accountability on reinvestment in the initially chosen failing department (escalating commitment). Original Simonson and Staw data are excluded from this selected estimate.

n.sample_role: Participants in the process-only and outcome-only accountability conditions of Experiments 1 and 2; pooled analytic participant n for this contrast is not explicitly printed. Two experiments contribute.
n.exclusions: Experiment 1 excluded 15 participants (5 refused videotaping, 4 wrong questionnaire, 2 uninterpretable answers, 3 suspicious, 1 premature termination), with 8 nonstudents outside the original sample; 205 remained across four conditions. Experiment 2 excluded 16 (10 technical problems, 3 procedural mistakes, 3 disbelief and/or quitting), with 10 failing inclusion criteria outside the original sample; 199 remained across three conditions. These full-study totals are not the analytic n of the two-condition meta-analysis.
n.location: p. 120, Meta-analysis; pp. 115 and 118, Participants and design (study-level exclusions).

notes:
The three assigned inputs have identical descriptions and locators; each independently maps to the same explicit process-versus-outcome planned contrast. They do not identify three distinguishable tests. No standardized effect size is printed for this original contrast, so none was calculated. Original sample values are condition-specific printed n, not a derived sum. The replication abstract/first-page preview was insufficient for the requested p. 120 meta-analysis; no statistics were taken from it.
Source follow-up: Fresh replication-only extraction from the supplied published-article text; title and DOI match the assigned reference. The three assigned records provide identical replication descriptions, study identifiers, and p. 120 locators, so each is matched independently to the explicitly described process-versus-outcome contrast; no distinct comparisons are inferred from audit ID or input order. This is the two-replication estimate, not the separate estimate including the original study (d = −0.30, p = .21). No pooled analytic participant n is printed for the selected contrast; no sample counts or effect metrics were calculated. Unassigned original side is a required placeholder, not an acquisition finding.
